evidence.text:
Atlas-R · 双编码器检索增强生成
Synthetic Research Team · 2020
This is an invented demonstration document, not a published paper.
A dual encoder retrieves passages and concatenates them with the question before generation.
The system is evaluated on a single-domain collection; cross-domain transfer remains untested.
Compare the retrieved passages with a manually annotated evidence set.
Definition 1. For a nonempty set R of relevant evidence and a retrieved set S, recall is |R intersection S| / |R|.
evidence.section: 原创数学教学样例 · 非真实论文

evidence.text: Lemma 1. If S is a subset of T, then R intersection S is a subset of R intersection T. Proof: any element in R intersection S belongs to R and S, hence to R and T.
evidence.section: 原创数学教学样例 · 非真实论文

evidence.text: Theorem 1. For fixed nonempty R and S subset T, recall(S) <= recall(T). Proof: Lemma 1 gives |R intersection S| <= |R intersection T|. Divide by the positive |R| and apply Definition 1. This says nothing about precision or answer accuracy.
evidence.section: 原创数学教学样例 · 非真实论文

nodes.label: Definition 1 · 证据召回率
nodes.statement: 设相关证据集合 R 非空，检索集合为 S，定义召回率为 |R ∩ S| / |R|。

nodes.label: Lemma 1 · 交集单调性
nodes.statement: 若 S ⊆ T，则 R ∩ S ⊆ R ∩ T。
conditions: S ⊆ T

nodes.label: Theorem 1 · 召回率单调性
nodes.statement: 在相关证据集合固定且非空、S ⊆ T 时，扩大检索集合不会降低该定义下的召回率。
conditions: R 固定且非空
S ⊆ T

evidence.text:
Fusion-R · 多文档解码融合
Synthetic Research Team · 2021
This is an invented demonstration document, not a published paper.
We extend Atlas-R by encoding each passage independently and fusing representations in the decoder.
Memory use grows with the number of retrieved passages. We leave adaptive passage selection to future work.
At a fixed retrieval budget, independent passage encoding improves evidence coverage in our synthetic benchmark.

Definition 1. In one normed vector space, a teaching fusion model is h = sum_i w_i h_i, for finitely many nonnegative weights with sum_i w_i = 1. This simplified model is not a description of a real decoder.
evidence.section: 原创数学教学样例 · 非真实论文

evidence.text: Lemma 1. For nonnegative weights and vectors in the same normed vector space, norm(sum_i w_i(h_i-h*)) <= sum_i w_i norm(h_i-h*). Proof: apply the triangle inequality and positive homogeneity of the norm.
evidence.section: 原创数学教学样例 · 非真实论文

evidence.text: Theorem 1. Under Definition 1, if every norm(h_i-h*) <= epsilon with epsilon >= 0, then norm(h-h*) <= epsilon. Proof: Definition 1 gives h-h* = sum_i w_i(h_i-h*). Lemma 1 bounds its norm by sum_i w_i epsilon = epsilon. This does not guarantee factual accuracy or apply to arbitrary nonlinear decoders.
evidence.section: 原创数学教学样例 · 非真实论文

nodes.label: Definition 1 · 加权表示融合
nodes.statement: 在同一赋范向量空间中，定义融合表示 h = Σ wᵢhᵢ，其中 wᵢ ≥ 0 且 Σ wᵢ = 1。
conditions: 有限个表示向量
非负归一化权重

nodes.label: Lemma 1 · 加权误差上界
nodes.statement: 对非负权重，有 ‖Σ wᵢ(hᵢ − h*)‖ ≤ Σ wᵢ‖hᵢ − h*‖。
conditions: 所有向量属于同一赋范向量空间
wᵢ ≥ 0

nodes.label: Theorem 1 · 融合表示误差界
nodes.statement: 若每个表示与目标 h* 的距离至多为 ε，则该加权融合表示与 h* 的距离也至多为 ε。
conditions: 采用 Definition 1 的融合模型
每个 ‖hᵢ − h*‖ ≤ ε，且 ε ≥ 0

evidence.text:
Loop-R · 迭代证据检索
Synthetic Research Team · 2022
This is an invented demonstration document, not a published paper.
Loop-R retrieves again using an intermediate answer as a reformulated query.
An incorrect intermediate answer may redirect retrieval to irrelevant passages.
Additional retrieval rounds increase evidence coverage on two-hop questions in this controlled setting.

Definition 1. Let U be a fixed finite evidence universe. Starting with S_0 subset U, the teaching retrieval loop updates S_(t+1) = S_t union R_t, where R_t subset U. Previously collected evidence is never removed.
evidence.section: 原创数学教学样例 · 非真实论文

evidence.text: Lemma 1. If S is a strict subset of T and T subset U for finite U, then |T| >= |S| + 1. Proof: T contains all elements of S and at least one element outside S.
evidence.section: 原创数学教学样例 · 非真实论文

evidence.text: Theorem 1. Under Definition 1, if every continuing update strictly enlarges S_t, there are at most |U|-|S_0| such updates. Proof: Definition 1 keeps all S_t inside U; Lemma 1 increases cardinality by at least one per update. Thus |S_0|+k <= |U|. No claim is made about answer correctness or loops that keep repeating the same evidence.
evidence.section: 原创数学教学样例 · 非真实论文

nodes.label: Definition 1 · 累积证据集合
nodes.statement: 定义第 t 轮累积证据 Sₜ，更新规则为 Sₜ₊₁ = Sₜ ∪ Rₜ，其中 Rₜ 为本轮检索结果。
conditions: 证据来自固定有限集合 U
不删除已经收集的证据

nodes.label: Lemma 1 · 新增证据计数
conditions: U 有限
S 为 T 的真子集

nodes.label: Theorem 1 · 有限证据扩展上界
nodes.statement: 若每个继续执行的更新都至少增加一条新证据，则成功扩展次数最多为 |U| − |S₀|。
conditions: 采用 Definition 1 的累积更新规则
每次继续更新均满足 Sₜ ⊂ Sₜ₊₁

evidence.text:
Reflect-R · 反思驱动的生成
Synthetic Research Team · 2023
This is an invented demonstration document, not a published paper.
Building on Loop-R, we add a reflection decision before each additional retrieval step.
The reflection classifier requires labeled examples and can fail under domain shift.
Skipping unnecessary retrieval reduces the number of retrieval calls in this evaluation.

Definition 1. For finitely many candidate steps with fixed costs c_i >= 0, the baseline cost is B = sum_i c_i. A teaching reflection policy executes subset A and incurs controller overhead H >= 0, so C = H + sum_(i in A) c_i.
evidence.section: 原创数学教学样例 · 非真实论文

evidence.text: Lemma 1. For a finite index set I and A subset I, sum_(i in I) c_i = sum_(i in A) c_i + sum_(i in I minus A) c_i. Proof: A and its complement partition I into disjoint sets.
evidence.section: 原创数学教学样例 · 非真实论文

evidence.text: Theorem 1. Under Definition 1, C <= B if and only if sum_(i not in A) c_i >= H. Proof: substituting Definition 1 and the decomposition in Lemma 1 yields B-C = sum_(i not in A) c_i-H. Its nonnegativity is exactly the stated condition. Cost savings alone do not imply preserved answer quality.
evidence.section: 原创数学教学样例 · 非真实论文

nodes.label: Definition 1 · 检索开销模型
nodes.statement: 设候选检索步骤开销 cᵢ ≥ 0，固定策略执行所有步骤；反思策略仅执行集合 A 中的步骤，另支付控制器开销 H ≥ 0。
conditions: 候选步骤有限
两种策略使用相同的单步检索开销

nodes.label: Lemma 1 · 省略步骤开销分解
nodes.statement: 总检索开销等于已选步骤开销与省略步骤开销之和。
conditions: A 是候选步骤集合的子集

nodes.label: Theorem 1 · 反思策略节省条件
nodes.statement: 当且仅当省略步骤的检索开销之和不小于 H 时，反思策略的总开销不超过固定策略。
conditions: 采用 Definition 1 的成本模型
计入控制器开销 H

evidence.text:
Verify-R · 引用支持核验
Synthetic Research Team · 2024
This is an invented demonstration document, not a published paper.
Each generated statement is paired with a passage and checked for textual support.
Textual support does not establish that the source passage itself is factually correct.
Unsupported statements are flagged for manual review rather than silently accepted.

Definition 1. For a fixed finite set Q of statements and fixed textual-support scores s(q) in [0,1], define A_tau = {q in Q: s(q) >= tau}, with tau in [0,1]. Scores measure the teaching checker output, not factual truth.
evidence.section: 原创数学教学样例 · 非真实论文

evidence.text: Lemma 1. If tau_1 <= tau_2, every score at least tau_2 is also at least tau_1. Proof: s >= tau_2 >= tau_1 by transitivity of the order on real numbers.
evidence.section: 原创数学教学样例 · 非真实论文

evidence.text: Theorem 1. Under Definition 1 and tau_1 <= tau_2, |A_(tau_2)| <= |A_(tau_1)|. Proof: Lemma 1 and Definition 1 give A_(tau_2) subset A_(tau_1); finite set cardinality preserves inclusion. This proves only count monotonicity, not better factual correctness or score calibration.
evidence.section: 原创数学教学样例 · 非真实论文

nodes.label: Definition 1 · 支持分数阈值集
nodes.statement: 对固定的有限陈述集合 Q，给定固定文本支持分数 s(q) ∈ [0,1]，定义通过集合 Aτ = {q ∈ Q : s(q) ≥ τ}。
conditions: Q 和各陈述分数固定

nodes.label: Lemma 1 · 阈值集合包含关系
nodes.statement: 若 τ₁ ≤ τ₂，则通过较高阈值的陈述也通过较低阈值。
conditions: 两次筛选使用相同分数

nodes.label: Theorem 1 · 通过数量单调性
nodes.statement: 在陈述和分数固定时，提高阈值不会增加通过的陈述数量，即 |Aτ₂| ≤ |Aτ₁|。
conditions: 采用 Definition 1 的固定集合与分数
τ₁ ≤ τ₂

directions.title: 让检索预算随证据需求变化
directions.problem: 多文档融合的内存开销与额外检索调用需要控制。
directions.hypothesis: 依据证据覆盖动态选择段落和检索轮数，可能在相近回答质量下减少开销。
directions.reasoning: Fusion-R 指出段落数量带来的内存问题；Reflect-R 展示检索调用可以按需跳过。这只构成实验动机。
directions.experiment: 固定生成模型与数据划分，对比固定段落数和自适应策略；记录答案质量、证据覆盖、内存和检索调用次数。
directions.failure_condition: 若覆盖率显著下降或控制器自身成本抵消节省，则假设不成立。
directions.reason: 示例中前提有依据；假设尚未验证。

directions.title: 检索链错误的早期识别
directions.problem: 中间答案错误可能污染后续检索，反思判断也可能受领域变化影响。
directions.hypothesis: 在新一轮检索前增加原文支持检查，可能降低错误传播。
directions.reasoning: 将 Loop-R 的错误传播风险与 Verify-R 的支持核验思路组合，尚需验证域外表现。
directions.experiment: 构造正确与错误中间答案两组，测量错误检索率、最终正确率与额外时延，并加入域外测试。
directions.failure_condition: 检查器无法识别错误，或引入过多误拒绝。
directions.reason: 组合策略的可行性仍需实验。
